lifecycle_setup_description: Prepares this machine: checks the container engine, checks the free disk, downloads the JGates tools image at the pinned version, creates the shared volumes and downloads the advisory data. Safe to run again: a ready machine finishes in seconds.
lifecycle_status_description: Shows whether this machine is ready: the engine, the tools image, extension images, the age of the advisory data, the dependencies and services of the current workspace and the disk JGates uses.
lifecycle_option_yes: Start a stopped container engine when its start command needs no administrator password, and wait for it.
lifecycle_option_no_data: Do not download the advisory data.
lifecycle_option_from: Load the tools image from a file written by 'jgates tools export' instead of downloading it.
lifecycle_doctor_deprecated: 'jgates doctor' is kept for compatibility; 'jgates status' shows the readiness of this machine and 'jgates setup' prepares it.
lifecycle_step_in_image: JGates is running inside the tools image: there is nothing to set up.
lifecycle_step_disk_unknown: The free disk could not be measured; the download goes on.
lifecycle_step_image_not_found: {image} is not in the engine after the download
lifecycle_step_volumes_created: {count, plural, one {# volume} other {# volumes}} created: {names}.
lifecycle_step_volumes_failed: The shared volumes could not be created: {error}
lifecycle_step_data_declined: Not downloaded (--no-data). Checks that need it stay incomplete.
lifecycle_step_data_fresh: Every database is up to date.
lifecycle_step_data_updated: {count, plural, one {# database} other {# databases}} updated.
lifecycle_step_data_failed: {count, plural, one {# database was} other {# databases were}} not updated: {names}.
lifecycle_step_data_error: The advisory data could not be downloaded: {error}
lifecycle_setup_not_ready: This machine is not ready yet.
lifecycle_status_ready: Ready: JGates can run checks on this machine.
lifecycle_status_not_ready: Not ready: JGates cannot run checks yet.
lifecycle_status_in_image: JGates is running inside the tools image; there is no engine to check.
lifecycle_status_engine: Engine: {state} (version {version}, {platform}, {memory} of memory, {cpus, plural, one {# CPU} other {# CPUs}})
lifecycle_status_extension: Extension images: {count, plural, one {# image} other {# images}} ({names})
lifecycle_status_data_header: Advisory data (limit {max, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}):
lifecycle_data_age: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} old, {state}
lifecycle_status_services: {count, plural, one {# service running} other {# services running}}
lifecycle_export_no_image: The image {image} is not in the engine, so there is nothing to export.
lifecycle_export_failed: The engine could not write the image {image}.
lifecycle_import_no_record: The record {file} that 'jgates tools export' writes next to the image is missing, so the image cannot be verified.
lifecycle_import_tarball_mismatch: The file {file} is not the one that was exported (its SHA-256 differs from the record). Nothing was loaded.
lifecycle_import_digest_mismatch: The engine holds another image than the one exported (expected {expected}, found {actual}).
lifecycle_import_pin_mismatch: The loaded image is not the one this JGates release pins ({expected}).
lifecycle_import_fix: Export the image again on the machine that has it and copy both files.
